title: Contract Navigation
outcome: Read a contract in sequence and preserve the records needed for a measured response.

steps.title: Identify the parties and roles

lines.text: List the named parties, signatories, notices contacts, and any entities acting through representatives.

speed_bumps: A trade name, parent company, and signing individual may not be the same legal party.

steps.title: Map obligations and consideration

lines.text: Mark each party's promised performance, payment or other consideration, conditions, and deadlines.

speed_bumps: Reading only a summary can omit terms incorporated by reference.

steps.title: Check default, notice, and cure provisions

lines.text: Follow the contract's stated notice address, delivery method, deadline, and opportunity to cure where applicable.

speed_bumps: A notice sent to the wrong address or without required delivery evidence may not satisfy the contract.

steps.title: Locate remedies and filing terms

lines.text: Record the contract's remedies, dispute-resolution process, governing-law clause, forum, and any filing deadlines.

speed_bumps: A contractual filing clause may be limited by mandatory law or court rules.
